subject: Pilot credits for Northfield Data Lab — scholarship request
messages:
From: Caitlin Norris <caitlin@northfieldlab.org>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Suresh Menon <suresh.menon@northfield.edu>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for pilot credits — non‑profit scholarship consideration

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the chat last week. Northfield Data Lab is preparing a six‑week pilot to evaluate LLM-assisted de‑identification and metadata extraction for a public‑health annotation corpus. We're a small non‑profit and funding is tight — we wanted to ask whether Redwood offers a scholarship or promotional credits for projects like this.

Scope in brief: ~200k tokens per week during the pilot, privacy safeguards (IRB approved), and open‑sourcing anonymized evaluation metrics at conclusion. I've attached a short pilot scope and the IRB summary.

Ideal ask: 50k USD credit + 30‑day trial extension on the hosted API so we can run incremental experiments without hitting quota limits. If you need a short usage forecast or project plan, happy to send.

Best,
Caitlin
Program Director, Northfield Data Lab
attachments: pilot_scope.pdf (application/pdf), irb_summary.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caitlin Norris <caitlin@northfieldlab.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pilot credits — non‑profit scholarship consideration

Hi Caitlin — thanks for the details and for sharing the IRB summary. This sounds aligned with the kinds of public‑interest pilots we support.

Two quick asks so I can fast‑track internally:
- Can you confirm projected token consumption weekly (you mentioned ~200k/week — is that peak or avg?)
- Do you need dedicated SLA or is hosted API with an extended trial sufficient?

I'll loop in Lauren (who owns nonprofit credits) and Aditya (finance) to confirm the discretionary credit path. If approved, typical package is a $30k–$50k credit + a 30‑60 day trial extension; we sometimes attach a short MOU for reporting commitments.

Markus
Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Caitlin Norris <caitlin@northfieldlab.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 08:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pilot credits — non‑profit scholarship consideration

Hi team — I reviewed the pilot_scope.pdf and IRB notes. Good alignment with our public‑interest credit guidelines. Proposed approval: $40,000 credit on hosted account + a 45‑day trial extension. Conditions:
- Northfield shares a brief tri‑weekly status update (email or short report)
- Attribution in any published materials (a one‑line acknowledgment)
- Single‑use promo code applied to the account; non‑transferable

Aditya — can you confirm accounting treatment and whether we need a one‑time waiver in the billing system? Caitlin — if that package works, we'll draft an MOU and send the promo code.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head, Nonprofit Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Caitlin Norris <caitlin@northfieldlab.org>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pilot credits — non‑profit scholarship consideration

Thanks — finance ok with the $40k in‑kind credit. A couple administrative notes:
- We'll issue a single promo code that deducts from hosted charges; it expires 60 days after activation.
- For our records we need a short statement on nonprofit status (501c3 equivalent) and a primary billing contact (even though there's no cash charge).
- No tax invoice will be generated for the credit itself; if Northfield later purchases additional services, normal invoicing applies.

Caitlin — can you reply with a scanned nonprofit certificate or a link to the registration? Once we have that we'll prepare the MOU and promo code.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Caitlin Norris <caitlin@northfieldlab.org>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pilot credits — non‑profit scholarship consideration

Hi Lauren/Aditya/Markus — wonderful news, thank you. Attached is our nonprofit registration (Northfield Data Lab — EIN 12‑3456789) and a short internal memo with the billing contact. We'll also commit to the tri‑weekly status updates and attribution language.

Next steps per your notes:
1) We'll review the draft MOU when you send it.
2) Please issue the promo code and share activation instructions.
3) We'll provide the first status update two weeks after activation.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this will make a big difference for the team.

Warmly,
Caitlin Norris
Program Director, Northfield Data Lab
attachments: northfield_501c3.pdf (application/pdf), billing_memo.txt (text/plain)
